Product Description Manufacture, Care and Fit

Upgrade your everyday essentials with Nobero’s premium 180 GSM T-Shirts, crafted from 100% combed cotton and treated with bio-wash and pre-shrunk technology for long-lasting comfort and durability. Designed with a classic crew neck and short sleeves, these tees are lightweight, breathable, and built for all-day wear whether you're out for a casual day, hitting the gym, or working from home.

Enjoy comfort-fit flexibility that moves with you, while the fabric stays soft, shape-retaining, and fade-resistant after every wash. Proudly made in India, every Nobero T-Shirt is a thoughtful blend of style and practicality.

Key Features:
• Lightweight & Breathable
• Bio-Washed & Pre-shrunk
• Comfort Fit for Daily Use
• Durable & Flexible Fabric
• Made in India

Wash Care:
Machine wash cold with mild detergent. Dry inside-out in shade. Avoid direct ironing on prints. Do not bleach or tumble dry. Dry flat to maintain shape.
